detailZh: 法国公开赛：迈克尔·金迎来“梦幻开局”后领跑，马特·菲茨帕特里克在国家高尔夫球场低杆频出的一天中表现出色
英格兰组合马特·菲茨帕特里克和萨姆·贝尔斯托在国家高尔夫球场落后早期领先者迈克尔·金两杆；汤米·弗利特伍德和维克托·霍夫兰等众多莱德杯明星也悉数登场；周五中午12点30分起可通过天空体育高尔夫频道观看直播
联邦快递法国公开赛首轮比赛集锦
在联邦快递法国公开赛上，马特·菲茨帕特里克落后早期领先者两杆，卫冕冠军迈克尔·金在国家高尔夫球场迎来“梦幻开局”后登上领先榜首位。
金在开局日打出无柏忌的63杆，全场抓下八只小鸟，其中前六个洞就有四只小鸟，在低杆频出的一天抢得两杆领先优势。

金在五杆洞第三洞未能抓住机会，但从第五洞开始连续两洞抓下小鸟，登上领先榜首位，随后又在五杆洞第九洞再抓一鸟，将领先追赶集团（包括菲茨帕特里克在内）的优势扩大到两杆。
"简直是梦幻般的开局，"金说， "我比赛的各个环节都非常出色，尤其是铁杆和推杆。我再也提不出比这更好的开局了。"
迈克尔·金以完美的开局开启了他的卫冕之旅，交出无柏忌的63杆（低于标准杆8杆），取得两杆领先。#法国公开赛

菲茨帕特里克也获得了无瑕疵的开局，打出六只小鸟、低于标准杆六杆的65杆，这位英格兰球手是首轮结束后并列第二的七名球员之一。
里斯顿·劳伦斯一度只落后领先者一杆，但在最后一洞吞下柏忌后回落至低于标准杆六杆，莱德杯热门人选克里斯托弗·赖坦和英格兰球手萨姆·贝尔斯托也落后两杆。
澳大利亚球手贾森·斯克里夫纳以及意大利组合乔治奥·德·莱奥和马泰奥·马纳塞罗是其他与菲茨帕特里克并列第二的球手，莱德杯副队长爱德华多·莫利纳里落后三杆，成绩为低于标准杆五杆。
“真是很不错的一天，”菲茨帕特里克说，“为本周开了一个好头，而且压力相对较小，这总是令人愉快——尤其是在这座高尔夫球场上。”

detailEn: Open de France: Michael Kim leads after 'dream start' as Matt Fitzpatrick impresses on low-scoring day at Le Golf National

English duo Matt Fitzpatrick and Sam Bairstow two behind early leader Michael Kim at Le Golf National; Tommy Fleetwood and Viktor Hovland among the other Ryder Cup stars in action; watch live on Friday from 12.30pm on Sky Sports Golf
Highlights from the opening round of the FedEx Open de France
Matt Fitzpatrick sits two shots off the early lead at the FedEx Open de France, as defending champion Michael Kim topped the leaderboard after a ‘dream start’ at Le Golf National.
Kim carded eight birdies, including four of his first six holes, to post a bogey-free 63 on a low-scoring opening day and grab a two-shot advantage.

Kim failed to take advantage of the par-five third but added back-to-back birdies from the fifth to move top of the leaderboard, then doubled his lead over the chasing pack - including Fitzpatrick - by picking up a shot at the par-five ninth.
"Just a dream start," Kim said. "All parts of my game were really good, especially my irons and my putting. I couldn't have asked for a better start."
Michael Kim with the perfect start to his title defence, with a bogey-free 63 (-8) which gives him a two-shot lead.#FedExOpenDeFrance pic.twitter.com/oLaiXPccLr

Fitzpatrick also made a blemish-free start, posting six birdies in a six-under 65, with the Englishman one of seven players sharing second after the opening round.
Thriston Lawrence was within one of the lead until a final-hole bogey dropped him back to six under, with Ryder Cup hopeful Kristoffer Reitan and England's Sam Bairstow also two back.

Australian Jason Scrivener and Italian duo Gerogio De Leo and Matteo Manassero are the others alongside Fitzpatrick in tied-second, with Ryder Cup vice-captain Edoardo Molinar three strokes back on five under.
"Really good day," Fitzpatrick said. "Great start to the week and relatively stress-free, which is always nice - particularly around this golf course."

Viktor Hovland is four off the early lead alongside American Ryan Gerard while Tommy Fleetwood - part of Europe's Ryder Cup-winning team at this venue in 2018 - started with a two-under 69.
Manuel Elvira, who double-bogeyed the 72nd hole to miss out on BMW PGA Championship victory on Sunday, sits second-bottom of the leaderboard after a nine-over 80.

detailEn: United States GP: Lewis Hamilton fastest from Max Verstappen in final practice ahead of Qualifying in Austin

Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton outpaced Red Bull's Max Verstappen in final practice in Austin with Friday's pace-setter Charles Leclerc in third; watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 10pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
Lewis Hamilton claims the fastest lap from Max Verstappen in final practice at the United States Grand Prix
Lewis Hamilton topped final practice from Max Verstappen at the United States Grand Prix to set up a tantalising qualifying in Austin.
Hamilton was 0.168s quicker than Verstappen as Ferrari and Red Bull look set to fight for pole position and victory for a second consecutive weekend.
Charles Leclerc topped both of Friday's sessions and had set the quickest time in final practice by one tenth from Hamilton, only for it to be deleted due to track limits.

Track limits is set to be a major issue for the drivers in qualifying, which takes place at 10pm UK time later on Saturday (build-up from 8.30pm live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event) due to the tarmac run-off areas and the drivers keen to use every bit of track to gain lap time.

Leclerc still finished the session in third, ahead of championship leader Kimi Antonelli whose chances of becoming the youngest world champion look extremely difficult, given he must first win the Grand Prix to give himself an opportunity, and Mercedes are a tad off the pace.
Antonelli was three tenths behind Hamilton's pace-setting time with his Mercedes team-mate George Russell in fifth at nearly half a second down.

McLaren's Lando Norris was eighth but would have been in the top five had his best lap not been deleted for track limit, while Oscar Piastri was sixth and Audi's Nico Hulkenberg impressing in seventh.
